The vision model is the pinned spatial fixture response; no provider was called.
Corpus values are synthetic (see protocol corpus.limits); learning lifts are associative and demonstrate the mechanism only.
Restart, concurrent promotion and retry-after-unknown are covered by the existing packet suites cited in the dossier, not re-run here.
